openQuestions: Official name in English and Ukrainian, canonical domain and postal address, from the official site and the EDEBO register.
Dated official statement for the current academic year on whether, where and how foreign students are taught.
State registration (EDEBO), programme licence (Ministry or EDEBO licence register) and NAQA accreditation for each health programme: three separate claims.
Which medicine, dentistry, pharmacy or nursing programmes admit foreign applicants, in which language, with what duration and intake, and the official fee page.

Relocation lead (unverified): No relocation lead: every result places the university in Dnipro (ust.edu.ua About page: 'a brand new, powerful technical university that established at the end of 2021, located in Dnipro'). It is itself the product of mergers: formed end-2021 'as a result of the union of four powerful educational institutions' whose 'former universities now function as educational and scientific institutes within one large university' (ust.edu.ua history/About, search summary); the Ukrainian State University of Chemical Technology and the Prydniprovska State Academy of Civil Engineering and Architecture were joined to it by Cabinet decree of 11 July 2023 No. 620-r (nmetau.edu.ua news) or 'in 2024' (ust.edu.ua About page) — the two dates conflict in the snippets; Times Higher Education says it incorporated the Prydniprovsk State Academy of Physical Culture and Sports in 2025. Opendatabot shows the predecessor National Metallurgical Academy of Ukraine (ЄДРПОУ 02070766) 'в стані припинення' through reorganisation. No suspension, licence-revocation or accreditation-problem lead was found.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Not a medical school: a technical university with 7 educational-scientific institutes (ust.edu.ua general-information); the only health-related lead is one pharmacy master's programme inherited through the merged chemical-technology university. No medicine, dentistry or nursing lead found.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: No lead shows the pharmacy programme admits foreign applicants or is taught in English; the only language statement ('Ukrainian and English as the languages of the educational process') is university-wide and programme-unspecific.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: The fees in the leads (53,500 UAH/yr 2025; 64,700 UAH/yr 2026) are domestic contract fees from an admissions aggregator, not international tuition — must not be presented as foreigner fees.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Name confusion: 'Science and Technologies' vs 'Science and Technology'; abbreviations UST vs USUST; the aggregator studyabroadaide.com files it under the slug 'national-metallurgical-academy-of-ukraine' and separately under its own name; predecessor hosts nmetau.edu.ua, udhtu.edu.ua and diit.edu.ua are still live in results. Also distinct from the similarly named Dnipro University of Technology (Dnipro Polytechnic) and Dnipro State Technical University (Kamianske), neither of which appeared in these results.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Conflicting merger dates for the chemical-technology university (Cabinet decree 11 July 2023 No. 620-r vs '2024' on the About page) — the legal successor status for the 226/I8 pharmacy licence is a lead only.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Admissions aggregator (vstup.osvita.ua) specialty code 'I8' reflects the new specialty classifier; the mapping to the former code 226 is an inference from the programme name, not from the snippet.
Missing evidence: Official programme page on ust.edu.ua for the pharmacy master's (name, level, duration, form, language) — only aggregator cards found; no official host could be opened.
Missing evidence: Any bachelor's-level pharmacy programme at USUST — not found.
Missing evidence: Whether foreign applicants are admitted to the pharmacy programme and whether any English-medium stream exists — not found.
Missing evidence: International tuition for foreign applicants — not found (only domestic contract fees in the leads).

Skeptic's note: No lead that the pharmacy programme admits foreign applicants or has an English-medium stream; the only language statement is university-wide.
